clusters.name: redirect-upstream-paths
clusters.executionModeRationale: Serial, single impl member. Although the per-story Rust files are disjoint (cli/, app-server-daemon/, tui/), the cross-cutting registration story US-004 edits patch-surface.md + both audit scripts and depends on the SANDBOX PATCH markers and invariant tests added by US-001-003. The two audit scripts are only green when every marker + KNOWN_PATCH_FILES entry + ENDPOINT_PATTERNS + guard lands together, so splitting risks a red-audit intermediate state. US-005 is an optional Scope-B story gated on operator decision at the HOLD.
